text:
Could VeriSign, Inc. (VRSN) Recover After Forming a Bullish Double Top Pattern? Posted by Michael Collier 54 am
The chart of VeriSign, Inc. (VRSN) shows a double top with $166.53 target or 7.00 % above today’s $155.64 share price. The 7 months chart pattern indicates low risk for the $18.82 billion company. It was reported on Jan, 10 by Finviz.com . If the $166.53 price target is reached, the company will be worth $1.32B more. Double tops are rare but powerful chart patterns.
The stock decreased 0.82% or $1.28 $155.64. About 860,769 shares traded. VeriSign, Inc. (NASDAQ:VRSN) has risen 39.16% uptrending. It has outperformed by 39.16% the S&P500.
Analysts await VeriSign, Inc. (NASDAQ:VRSN) to report earnings on February, 7 after the close. They expect $1.12 EPS, up 25.84 % or $0.23 from last year’s $0.89 per share. VRSN’s profit will be $135.39M for 34.74 P/E if the $1.12 EPS becomes a reality. VeriSign, Inc. provides domain name registry services and Internet security worldwide. The company has market cap of $18.82 billion. The firm offers registry services that operate the authoritative directory of .com, .net, .cc, .tv, and .name domain names, as well as the back-end systems for .gov, .jobs, .edu, and other domain names. It has a 38.17 P/E ratio. The Company’s registry services allow individuals and organizations to establish their online identities.
